STRICTLY_NOT_A_GATE: Does not authorise EVAL, does not alter the model, cannot substitute for the frozen crossover gate. A strong mechanism result with a failed crossover is still CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED.

UNITS_CORRECTION.problem: The spec places v1_baseline 0.0051 and teacher_reference_contrast 0.3919 side by side and derives '1.3% of available teacher contrast' from their ratio, but they are in different units.
UNITS_CORRECTION.detail: _jsd_from_logits (V1's path, reused here) uses natural log, so all model JSD figures including V1's 0.0051 are NATS. diagnose_teacher_contrast.py used log2, so 0.3919 is BITS.
UNITS_CORRECTION.consequence: V1-to-OG-PSP JSD comparison is unaffected: both come from the same function and are both nats. Only the ratio against teacher contrast was wrong. Correctly converted, V1 reproduced 0.0188 of teacher contrast, not 0.013.
UNITS_CORRECTION.handling: Both nats and bits are reported for every JSD figure below.

THRESHOLD_DISCLOSURE: Thresholds operationalising the spec's qualitative readings were frozen in code before this ran, anchored to V1's baseline and the measured teacher contrast. While monitoring the run for operational health I had seen the training log's [Actor Z] sep_JSD field (~0.021 in the tail), a different quantity measured on live rollout states rather than these branch states. Disclosed because thresholds set after any related observation are not fully blind.

verdict.meaning: Differentiation is materially above V1 but below the frozen 'substantial' bar, or the two measures disagree. The spec froze qualitative readings; this outcome sits between them and is NOT binned autonomously.

authorizes: nothing; opening EVAL requires a separate PI decision

ADDENDUM_1_MATCHED_CALIB_COMPARISON.status: context added AFTER the primary reading; the READING above is unchanged
ADDENDUM_1_MATCHED_CALIB_COMPARISON.why_this_was_added: The headline FIT figures are NOT comparable between V1 and OG-PSP: V1's FIT was 428 legacy states, OG-PSP's FIT is the 1,804-state expanded bank. Reading own-teacher match as having 'dropped' from V1's 0.9467 to OG-PSP's 0.8036 would be comparing different state sets. CALIB is identical for both runs (10700097..10700128, n=145, never trained on by either), so it is the only strictly matched comparison available, and both sides were frozen before use.
ADDENDUM_1_MATCHED_CALIB_COMPARISON.reading_of_the_matched_comparison: On the identical held-out split OG-PSP is better than V1 on every measure: 6.39x the latent divergence, and both own-teacher matches improved rather than degraded (+4.21 pp and +14.50 pp). The 'retention may fall by design' disclosure frozen before training did not materialise on this split.
ADDENDUM_1_MATCHED_CALIB_COMPARISON.what_it_does_NOT_establish: Crossed gaps are not compared here because V1's diagnostic never computed crossed cells on CALIB; V1's +1.67/+2.09 pp reference is FIT-only. And none of this is the crossover gate, which remains the frozen EVAL.
